title: Kalshi takes legal blow in court ruling confirming state powers over prediction markets
summary: This latest U.S. appeals court ruling sets up a rift between federal courts on event contracts, suggesting the U.S. Supreme Court may need to settle the matter.

title: Solana vote to double disinflation passes by a hair in dramatic finish
summary: Solana's first network-wide vote went down to the wire, with Kraken and Galaxy-linked validators switching sides before the disinflation proposal narrowly passed.

title: BitGo to buy NYDIG trading arm for $42.5M in cash and stock plus $15M earnout
summary: The deal to buy NYDIG IF Holdings comprises $7 million in cash and around $35.5 million in stock, as well as the $15 earnout.

title: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh at Jackson Hole: 'We have work to do' on inflation
summary: Warsh's highly anticipated remarks at the Kansas City Fed's annual symposium Friday morning leaned hawkish, prompting traders to quickly raise bets on a September rate hike.

title: The Clarity Act slipped to September. Banks are building anyway
summary: But every month without settled rules quietly rewards the walled garden, writes Matter Labs’ Vassilis Tziokas.
